definitions.full: H4130. modaath [ מֹדַ֫עַת ] noun feminine kindred, kinship — singular suffix מֹדַעְתָּנוּ Ruth 3:2 is not Boaz (of) our kindred ?

occurrences.englishText: Now isn’t Boaz our kinsman, with whose maidens you were? Behold, he will be winnowing barley tonight on the threshing floor.
